semiconductor_relevance: High - AS Strömungstechnik GmbH specializes in safe dispensing and filling systems for liquid chemicals, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: AS Strömungstechnik GmbH provides innovative solutions for the intelligent handling and safe dispensing of liquid chemicals used in semiconductor manufacturing. Their products ensure the protection of both personnel and valuable chemicals, making them a trusted partner for major companies in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Safe dispensing systems for liquid chemicals
Automated filling and emptying robotic systems
Custom fittings, valves, and hoses made from high-performance plastics
IoT solutions for sustainable chemical handling

regional_presence.Europe: The company is based in Ostfildern near Stuttgart, Germany, and has foreign subsidiaries in America and Asia to ensure customer proximity.
